parent_objective: audit materialized objective pass before any actor update design
blocked_by: M1107 objective sanity passes but cannot directly admit actor update without audit
invalidates: direct actor update from objective sanity pass
claiming driver improvement from auxiliary objective

public_gates: M1108 must not train actor weights
M1108 must not run corpus build or objective sanity
M1108 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not interpret objective sanity pass as driver improvement

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1107 objective pass and decides whether guarded actor update design is admissible
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no actor training, PPO, replay, corpus build, objective run, promotion, or private holdout
stop_condition: stop if objective pass is too narrow for actor update design
stop if corpus sparsity or target imbalance requires repair
stop if required post-update gates are unclear
fallback_plan: if objective pass is sufficient, route to guarded actor update design
if corpus imbalance is concerning, route to corpus expansion or weighting design
if objective signal is likely metric artifact, route to objective audit/ablation

training_stage.stage_objective: audit objective sanity before any actor update
blocked_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not promote from objective sanity
allowed_updates: pre-register next route if audit is clear
update status, queue, scoreboard, and review artifacts

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1108 audits matched-current objective sanity and cannot upgrade to anticipatory self-identification.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1108 audits existing M1107 artifacts only and adds no new temporal task.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If objective pass is insufficient for actor update, route to corpus/objective audit rather than actor update.
allowed_claims: objective-pass audit for a level2 replay-calibrated proof surface
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: The M1107 objective pass is strong enough to admit a tightly guarded actor-update design, but not an actor update itself.
success_criteria: required guarded actor update gates are explicit if admitted
no actor training, PPO, replay, corpus build, objective sanity, mining, promotion, or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: actor training, PPO, replay, corpus build, objective sanity, mining, promotion, or private holdout starts
decision_rule: M1108 may only audit M1107 objective sanity. It cannot train actor weights, run PPO, run replay, run corpus build, run objective sanity, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, or change actor inputs.
